comment: worn.c mon_break_armor() 1190: the Priestess rings herself with eight wished sets of red dragon scales; a tame hill orc picks one up and wears it as body armor (gray scales would give it magic resistance against the wand). A wand of polymorph with monpolycontrol turns it into a red dragon, so the worn scales match Dragon_scales_to_pm() and merge with no message before m_useup(). Variation from the shirt recipes: body armor and a matching dragon form.
